title: 第2111章 这是个果盘儿第2110章 相逢于微末
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 楚星河这会儿都懵了……
不是……这什么情况？这边儿聊着聊着怎么特么又成了我楚星河背功了？
我特么今天没说话啊，我完全属于是站在人群里面看热闹吃瓜的！
结果吃着吃着，这吃瓜吃自己头上了？
而且什么就特么星河之光？
上一把星河之光现在还在那边儿切水果呢。
咋的？你这星河之光系列还特么跟水果有关系啊？
这会儿不光楚星河一脸懵逼，全场都是一脸懵逼！
毕竟星河之光乃是欧阳明成名之战所炼制出来的，也是欧阳明借此告诉所有人，他对星河师兄的深深感激。
你甭管那把星河之光是不是用来切水果了，但直至今日，全四洲也只有这一把星河之光。
欧阳明每个月都会炼制出无数的神器，可是这些神器无论多么强大，欧阳明也从来没有用星河之光来进行过命名。
那是因为在欧阳明的眼中，它们还不配叫这个名字！
可是今天，这银盘乃是一件上品灵器，一件上品灵器欧阳明竟然打算用星河之光还是系列来命名，这多少有些过于离谱了吧！
而就在所有人的目光之中，欧阳明命人拿来了哈密瓜……不对……应该是灵云果！
众所周知，炼器宫每个月最大的消耗就是灵云果，你别问灵云果都被用来干啥了！
问就是用来炼器了！
什么玩意儿？你说谁家好人把灵云果炼器炼进肚子里面了？
朋友！一个炼器师在炼器炼制到最艰难的时候，想要用星河之光切个灵云果助助兴，请问有什么问题吗？
吃完灵云果之后，炼器师们可以大大的强化自身，提高炼器的成功率和效果，这难道不是炼器的一部分吗？
所以说灵云果用来炼器了有什么问题吗？
而此时看着欧阳明拿出来灵云果，楚星河都懵了……
这特么星河之光还真跟水果有关系？
所以星河之光是水果系列呗？
而就在所有人都纳闷欧阳明拿出灵云果到底是打算搞什么的时候，欧阳明直接将灵云果放在了银盘之上。
当灵云果落在银盘的一刹那，所有人发现，这银盘之中好像突然有什么力量被激活了！
随之就见银盘之中开始有一道道的力量钻入了灵云果之中，下一秒灵云果之上出现了一层寒霜！
看到被冰镇的灵云果，全场都懵了！
这特么是个果盘儿？
大长老：“欧阳啊，你别告诉我，这是个果盘儿！”
很显然这会儿不光楚星河，大家都是一样的想法！
所以星河之光的刀是水果刀，星河之光的银盘是果盘儿是吗？
欧阳明看着一脸问号的大长老随之开口道：“大长老莫要着急！”
话语落下，欧阳明露出了一个神秘莫测的笑容，随之欧阳明从供桌上将星河之光的刀请了出来！
提着星河之光的刀，欧阳明走到了果盘之前，挥动手中的刀对着星河之光果盘儿上面的灵云果就切了上去。
content_en:
;;
Chu Xinghe was confused now...
No...what's going on? While we are chatting here, why the hell is it me, Chu Xinghe, who is taking the blame again?
I didn’t say anything today. I just stood in the crowd and watched the excitement!
As a result, as you eat, you end up eating something wrong?
And what the hell is the light of the galaxy?
The last Light of the Galaxy is still cutting fruit there.
What? Does your Galaxy of Light series have anything to do with fruits?
At this moment, not only Chu Xinghe was confused, but the entire audience was confused!
After all, the Light of Galaxy was refined through Ouyang Ming's battle to become famous, and it was also Ouyang Ming's way of telling everyone his deep gratitude to Senior Brother Xinghe.
You don't care whether that handful of Galaxy's Light is used to cut fruit, but to this day, there is only this handful of Galaxy's Light in the entire four continents.
Ou Yangming refines countless artifacts every month, but no matter how powerful these artifacts are, Ou Yangming has never named them after the light of the galaxy.
That's because in Ouyang Ming's eyes, they don't deserve this name!
But today, this silver plate is a high-grade spiritual weapon. Ou Yangming actually plans to name a high-grade spiritual weapon after the light of the galaxy or the series. This is a bit too outrageous!
And while everyone was watching, Ouyang Ming ordered someone to bring a cantaloupe... No... it should be Lingyun Fruit!
As we all know, the biggest consumption in the Refining Palace every month is Lingyun Fruit. Don’t ask what Lingyun Fruit is used for!
I asked if it was used for refining weapons!
What the hell? Who do you think a good person put into their stomachs while refining the Lingyun Fruit?
friend! When a weapon refining master is at his most difficult moment, he wants to use the light of the galaxy to cut a Lingyun Fruit to cheer him up. Is there any problem?
After eating the Lingyun Fruit, the weapon refining masters can greatly strengthen themselves and improve the success rate and effect of the weapon refining. Isn't this part of the weapon refining?
So is there any problem if Lingyun Fruit is used to refine weapons?
At this moment, Chu Xinghe was stunned when he saw Ouyang Ming taking out the Lingyun Fruit...
Is this fucking starry light really related to fruit?
So the Light of the Galaxy is a fruit series?
And just when everyone was wondering what Ouyang Ming was planning to do with the Lingyun Fruit, Ouyang Ming directly placed the Lingyun Fruit on the silver platter.
The moment the Lingyun Fruit landed on the silver plate, everyone discovered that some power seemed to be suddenly activated in the silver plate!
Then I saw that the power in the silver plate began to penetrate into the Lingyun Fruit, and a layer of frost appeared on the Lingyun Fruit in the next second!
Seeing the frozen Lingyun Fruit, the whole audience was stunned!
Chu Xinghe: "???"
What the hell is this a fruit plate?
Great Elder: "Ouyang, don't tell me, this is a fruit plate!"
Obviously, not only Chu Xinghe, but everyone has the same idea at this moment!
So the knife of Galaxy Light is a fruit knife, and the silver plate of Galaxy Light is a fruit plate, right?
Ouyang Ming looked at the First Elder with a question mark on his face and said, "First Elder, don't be anxious!"
After the words fell, Ouyang Ming showed a mysterious smile, and then Ou Yangming took out the sword of Galaxy Light from the altar table!
Holding the Galaxy Light knife, Ouyang Ming walked to the fruit plate, waved the knife in his hand and cut the Lingyun fruit on the Galaxy Light fruit plate.
